ox.skill.copy.description: Copy one resolved skill, including references and helpers into a new Profile-owned skill: `await ox.skill.copy({ purpose, source, name })`. The destination name is normalized to lowercase kebab-case and must not already exist. Service dependencies are retained.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.skill.create.description: Create one Profile-owned skill: `await ox.skill.create({ purpose, name, description, instructions, services? })`. Read evolve for skill authoring and verification. Create when requested or when observed work establishes a useful reusable workflow; improve a relevant existing skill before creating an overlapping one. No separate proposal confirmation is needed within the task's scope. The name is normalized to lowercase kebab-case and creation fails rather than replacing an existing skill.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.skill.delete.description: Delete one writable skill: `await ox.skill.delete({ purpose, name })`. Read-only compatibility snapshots and installed repository skills cannot be deleted.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.skill.run.description: Run a packaged JavaScript helper in this Ox VM. The script is an async function body with ox and args parameters. It uses normal Action permissions. Read the skill instructions first.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.skill.share.description: Copy the complete resolved skill into the Local repository for review and versioned storage. Fails if Local already contains the name.
